citations.claim: body west of thin wall just before crossing
body jumped 2m past wall with unchanged velocity, proving tunnel through wall 0 between steps 4 and 5
velocity unchanged across the crossing, no wall impulse applied

explanation: Fast circle (vx=60, dt=1/30) hits thin wall (w=0.1 at x=10). At step 4 centre sits at wall face with radius overlapping the wall (penetration 0.5), then advances ~2m in one step to x=12 with vx still 60. Substepped CCD/impulse failed to stop a thin-wall crossing at high speed, yielding no_wall_penetration at step 4 then no_tunneling at step 5.

violation.detail: body centre moved through wall 0 between steps 4 and 5

vision_note: The red circle moves right toward the vertical wall and contacts it at step 4. At step 5 it appears on the opposite side of the wall, having passed straight through without bouncing.
